title: Atomic heading with an out-of-enum tag value (PHP dry_run rejects: ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID)
_comment: Seed bootstrap INVALID fixture (WP-F06, 14-fixtures-harness.md §3, Detailed-Req #3). The `tag` is a correctly-TYPED string envelope ([R8]) but its value "h7" is outside the heading tag enum [h1..h6] (atomic-heading.php:48), so the live Props_Parser throws "Settings validation failed." → caught and classified as ATOMIC_SETTINGS_INVALID (has-atomic-base.php:113; 12-error-taxonomy.md §3.1). prefilter.verdict:defer — the TS pre-filter is STRUCTURAL only and does NOT know the live enum (it defers enum/conditional validity to PHP, §4); the meta-invariant constrains only accept⇒valid and reject⇒invalid, so defer on an invalid fixture is permitted and keeps the subset test green against the real pre-filter.
